definitions.explanation: The illegal transportation of goods across borders, evading customs and legal restrictions.

examples.japanese: {密輸|みつゆ}で{逮捕|たいほ}された。
{麻薬|まやく}の{密輸|みつゆ}が{摘発|てきはつ}された。
{税関|ぜいかん}は{密輸|みつゆ}を{防|ふせ}ぐために{厳|きび}しい{検査|けんさ}を{行|おこな}っている。
examples.english: Customs conducts strict inspections to prevent smuggling.

notes:
Compound of {密|みつ} (secret) + {輸|ゆ} (transport). Functions as a する verb ({密輸|みつゆ}する = to smuggle).

USAGE:
Commonly encountered in news reporting about illegal trade. The verb form {密輸|みつゆ}する means "to smuggle." The person who smuggles is {密輸|みつゆ}{業者|ぎょうしゃ} (smuggler) or {密輸|みつゆ}{犯|はん} (smuggling offender).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {密輸|みつゆ}する — to smuggle
- {密輸|みつゆ}{品|ひん} — smuggled goods, contraband
- {密輸|みつゆ}{業者|ぎょうしゃ} — smuggler
- {密輸|みつゆ}ルート — smuggling route
- {武器|ぶき}の{密輸|みつゆ} — arms smuggling

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {密売|みつばい} — illegal sale, black market dealing (selling, not transporting)
- {密入国|みつにゅうこく} — illegal entry into a country (people, not goods)
- {闇取引|やみとりひき} — black market transaction (broader, includes domestic illegal trade)
